name: King Halvard III
title: The Silver Line
examine: The crown sits on him the way snow sits on the mountain: quietly, heavily, and as if it had always been there.
lines: My grandfather cut the third terrace. My father paved the road you climbed. I sign papers. The Line, you'll notice, is getting comfortable.
A king outranks everything on this mountain except the mountain. Maren speaks for the mountain. Watch how carefully I listen to Maren.
The forge shift works harder than I do and I pay them accordingly. The crown is only heavy if you wear it wrong.
